$comment: Exceptions for build/npm/check-package-age.ts. The internal npm feed only serves npmjs.com versions that are at least 7 days old. 'packages' lists names or '@scope/*' patterns the feed mirrors from internal upstreams without that delay; these were derived from versions merged to main while younger than 7 days (July to October 2026) and from probing the feed. 'versions' lists exact 'name@version' entries a feed owner made available early; give a reason or link and remove the entry once the version is older than 7 days. See .github/instructions/npm-dependencies.instructions.md.
